name: Feature Kanban
description: Product/PM feature workflow for customer research, PRDs, prototypes, naming, release notes, documentation, and launch readiness.
author: Squadboard team

project.name: Feature Kanban
project.description: Track product feature work from customer signal through PRD, prototype, documentation, launch readiness, and done.

skills.name: Customer Research
skills.description: Gather, deduplicate, and rank customer signals for product decisions.

skills.name: PRD Writing
skills.description: Write concise PRDs with testable requirements, metrics, risks, and rollout plans.

skills.name: Prototype Creation
skills.description: Plan lightweight prototypes that validate the riskiest assumption quickly.

skills.name: Feature Naming
skills.description: Generate clear, reusable, customer-facing feature names.

skills.name: Feature Disclosure
skills.description: Write concise release notes, changelog entries, and feature announcements.

skills.name: Feature Documentation
skills.description: Plan and draft user-facing documentation for new or changed features.

seedIssues.title: [SIGNAL] Trial users abandon onboarding after the import step
seedIssues.body: Recent feedback suggests new users understand the value proposition but get stuck when asked to import existing data. Gather examples, identify the confusing step, and recommend one product change that would reduce drop-off.

seedIssues.title: [FEATURE] Guided first-run checklist for new workspaces
seedIssues.body: Create a PRD for a lightweight first-run checklist that helps new teams invite collaborators, add their first item, and run their first review. Include success metrics and non-goals.

seedIssues.title: [PROTOTYPE] Compare two approaches for bulk item editing
seedIssues.body: Prototype two flows for selecting multiple items, changing status, and applying labels. Capture the riskiest usability questions and the minimum artifact needed for a decision.

seedIssues.title: [DOCS] Draft release note for saved filters
seedIssues.body: Write a short release note that explains the customer value of saved filters, what is new, prerequisites or limitations, and a getting-started link placeholder.

seedIssues.title: [VALIDATION] Define launch metrics for notification preferences
seedIssues.body: Identify activation, adoption, retention, and quality metrics for a notification-preferences launch. Include instrumentation gaps and a ship/hold recommendation template.
